source: Carroll MD, Kit BK, Lacher DA, Shero ST, Mussolino ME. Trends in lipids and lipoproteins in US adults, 1988–2010. JAMA 2012.
locator: Table 1, 2007–2010 column, both sexes, all race/ethnicity groups, age 20+, all medication statuses
standard: Direct age standardization to the projected 2000 US distribution using 20–39, 40–59 and 60+; survey-weighted arithmetic means. The intervals concern means, not individual observations.
applicability: Earlier US surveillance period, no matching of medications or other case mix across periods. The two means carry no new within-person joint information. Target mixture is US adults, age standardized. No numerical target-period data are supplied.
